# Combobox props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labels` | `Partial<ComboboxLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_COMBOBOX_LABELS`. An `aria-label` on a part takes precedence. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `string` | `"Show options"` | Name of `Combobox.Trigger` when it renders the default icon. |
| `clear` | `string` | `"Clear selection"` | Name of `Combobox.Clear`, whatever its content. |
| `chipRemove` | `string` | `"Remove"` | Name of `Combobox.ChipRemove`, read with its chip's text. `{chip}` marks where the text goes: `"{chip} を削除"` reads "Apple を削除". Without `{chip}`, the text follows the label, so the default reads "Remove Apple". Only the first `{chip}` counts. |
